promptText: LOCAL LOWER-BODY EDIT of image1 only: exact same alchemy boy, original full-canvas framing. Freeze the head/hair/face/neck, torso ABOVE BELT, both arms/hands and held props, bag/scrolls/ribbons/robe silhouette at original size and positions. Do not enlarge/recenter or move the full character. Camera is SOUTH toward viewer, front camera. Both boot long axes stay straight toward viewer; no sideways yaw, no duck-footV. Front-to-back displacement is DEPTH away from viewer, not movement to screen-left/right. Anatomical right is screen-left, anatomical left screen-right. Image2 is this same boy's correct supporting-foot mechanics reference ONLY: use its planted ankle/sole and weight-bearing relationship, not its head pose or entire figure. Image3 is approved painting/material style only, no UI. This frame has anatomical RIGHT as the ONLY grounded WEIGHT-BEARING SUPPORT foot; anatomical LEFT is the raised recovering/swing foot. SECOND drawing of REAR-END FOREFOOT PUSH pair, final contact before other leg takes over. Same supporting leg reaches slightly farther BACK, heel raised higher and push stronger, but FOREFOOT/TOE stays continuously planted and compressed against the ground. Knee extended naturally, never hyperextended. Opposite leg extends forward ready to land next frame, heel approaching ground but still slightly lifted. Do NOT turn this frame into flight: the rear toe must carry the body until next-foot landing. Redraw both legs below the belt as necessary for correct connections, retaining exact original ivory baggy pants, jade-gold floral boots, and proportions. Keep every support contact readable from a flattened contacting sole/forefoot, natural knee flex, and hip-to-ankle load path. Moving foot back is a new drawn anatomical pose, never a cutout translation or warp. No added floor/shadow/ground marks are needed. At every frame at least one foot is clearly grounded. Keep the support toe at the correct projected ground plane matching reference2 and scene perspective; do not raise it to fake stance or plant a hovering shoe. Preserve the original target head/body scale and safe canvas margins; front planted soles near original ground level, rear ground contact follows modest perspective depth. Original RIGHT hand bronze cauldron and LEFT hand green bottle remain exactly unchanged, no new accessories, no mirror, no swapped limbs. Deliver ONE native1254x1254 RGBA transparent sprite with original1024 framing proportionally preserved, clean alpha, no background/text, original bright orange/jade/ivory/gold detailed Chinese chibi painting.
